purpose: Align legacy public article moves with canonicalization guidance and validate all generated migration routes.

policy.articleMoves: Immediate meta refresh, destination canonical and visible continuation link; no noindex on public article move pages.
policy.otherMoves: Keep noindex on root, navigation and example redirects.
policy.hosting: HTTP 200 static meta refresh, not a server 301.
policy.sitemap: Only existing canonical public URLs; redirect routes remain excluded.

limits: Static output checks are not evidence of Google re-crawling, indexing, canonical selection or ranking effects.
No new Search Console or Analytics collection during this change; previous private baseline remains unchanged.
No production deployment performed by this change.
